args.body:
• Corvid Packaging newsletter: this quarter's focus is freight pricing.
• Main article (blog.corvid.example/2026/freight): spot rates fell 9% while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/freight/companion): shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Corvid Packaging Freight Pricing Summary
